read_ranges.body:
1: use crate::core::math::{Mat4, Vec3, Vec4};
2: 
3: use crate::graphics::scene::scene_renderer::primitives::LineVertex;
4: 
5: /// 将模型局部包围盒投到实例世界空间，供选中高亮描边；调用方负责选择实体和资源驻留。
6: pub(crate) fn append_bounding_box_vertices(
7:     vertices: &mut Vec<LineVertex>,
8:     min: Vec3,
9:     max: Vec3,
10:     transform: Mat4,
11:     color: Vec4,
12: ) {
13:     let corners = [
14:         Vec3::new(min.x, min.y, min.z),
15:         Vec3::new(max.x, min.y, min.z),
16:         Vec3::new(max.x, max.y, min.z),
17:         Vec3::new(min.x, max.y, min.z),
18:         Vec3::new(min.x, min.y, max.z),
19:         Vec3::new(max.x, min.y, max.z),
20:         Vec3::new(max.x, max.y, max.z),
21:         Vec3::new(min.x, max.y, max.z),
22:     ]
23:     .map(|corner| transform.transform_point3(corner));
24:     for (a, b) in [
25:         (0, 1),
26:         (1, 2),
27:         (2, 3),
28:         (3, 0),
29:         (4, 5),
30:         (5, 6),
31:         (6, 7),
32:         (7, 4),
33:         (0, 4),
34:         (1, 5),
35:         (2, 6),
36:         (3, 7),
37:     ] {
38:         vertices.push(LineVertex::new(corners[a], color));
39:         vertices.push(LineVertex::new(corners[b], color));
40:     }
41: }
